_comment: Debt ceiling, not a target. Per-class so a drop in one class cannot mask a regression in another. Lower it as cleanup lands; raising it is rejected by `node scripts/knip-ratchet.mjs --check-baseline-diff`. Re-measured after merging origin/develop, which added packages/mcp-server-plugin and further code between this branch point and the PR: exports 227->234, types 189->193, duplicates 11->12. This is the establishing commit, so there is no prior ceiling to raise; every later change is held to these numbers. See change: add-knip-dead-code-oracle.
